product_one_liner.value: Quantum Metric helps enterprise product, engineering, and customer-experience teams understand web and mobile customer behavior, diagnose friction, and prioritize improvements by business impact.

pricing_page.notes: Public page describes custom enterprise plans, included capabilities, add-ons, and pricing factors, without numerical prices.

eng_blog.notes: Engineering writing is on engineering leader Eric Irwin’s personal Medium blog: two posts explain Quantum Metric’s Backstage system architecture and ephemeral-environment infrastructure; this is not a separately branded company engineering blog.

public_docs.notes: No public multi-article product documentation portal found; the docs address redirects to the marketing site. Customer integration documentation requires login; selected public GitHub READMEs are not a full product help center.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The live job board lists sales, solutions-engineering, and industry-leadership roles, but no qualifying AI, ML, or data-science title.

model_provider.notes: The company’s April 4, 2024 Felix AI announcement explicitly names this model; its subprocessor list also identifies Google for in-platform AI.

compliance_certs.notes: SOC 2 attestation and ISO/IEC 27001 certification are explicitly claimed. GDPR is a compliance claim, not a certification. PCI DSS and HIPAA references describe data protections or support for customers’ compliance, not company certification.

raised_18mo.notes: Latest reported round is January 2021, before the May 9, 2025–November 9, 2026 window.

launched_6mo.notes: Quantum Metric MCP became generally available on October 22, 2026, within May 9–November 9, 2026.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: On January 5, 2026, Kartik Chandrayana announced his departure from the Chief Product Officer operating role and transition to advisor, within the requested window.

crm_stack_signal.notes: The live Enterprise Account Executive posting explicitly names Salesforce as an example CRM; this is a hiring-stack signal rather than a definitive deployment statement.
